subject: ACME - Mutual Action Plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: ACME - Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Hi Jordan / Sanjay —

Thanks again for the call earlier — really appreciate you walking through the evaluation priorities and the internal stakeholders. As discussed, I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the proposed owners, milestones, and recommended evaluation activities. High level: 

- Goals: validate latency & cost at scale, confirm quality on key prompts, and verify integration with your API gateway.
- Proposed timeline: kickoff week of 5/24, evaluation window 2–3 weeks, decision by 6/30.
- Owners (proposed): Jordan (Product), Sanjay (IT/Security), Marissa (Redwood AM), Rachel (CS lead for onboarding).

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf, Redwood-Eval-Checklist.xlsx

Can you please: 
1) Confirm owners above (or suggest alternates)
2) Confirm whether the proposed timeline still works for your team
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 30m calibration call next week to assign tasks and unblock procurement.

Next steps from our side once owners/timing are confirmed: we'll finalize the MAP, schedule the kickoff, and provision a short-lived eval environment (no production data required).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan / Sanjay —

Just bumping this in case it got buried. Quick summary: we sent a draft MAP on 5/12 and asked for owner + timeline confirmation so we can lock in a kickoff slot the week of 5/24.

If the timeline has shifted on your side, no problem — just tell us the new target and we’ll adjust. If it helps, Marcus (cc'd) can run through a shortened version of the plan with your technical lead — 20–30m to align owners and requirements.

If I don't hear back by EOD Tues (5/18) I'll follow up with a suggested calendar slot.

Thanks,

Marissa

Hi Jordan / Sanjay —

Rachel here from the Customer Success team, looping in to help move the MAP along. Marissa mentioned she hadn't heard back and I wanted to check whether you still plan to start the evaluation in late May / early June. Two quick options to unblock: 

1) Confirm owners + timeline by reply (we'll finalize the MAP and send calendar invites)
2) Book a 20m slot with Marcus and me — we'll walk through the checklist and assign responsibilities. Suggested slots: Wed 5/19 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 5/20 14:00–14:30 PT.

If priorities have shifted and you're not evaluating right now, a quick reply to let us know the new timeline would be great — we can archive the draft MAP and re-open when ready.

Thanks, and happy to be flexible on timing.

- Rachel
